findings.problem: Remove duplicate primary key entries in products
findings.fix: Duplicate primary key entries in the 'products' table violate data integrity. This fix will delete duplicate rows, keeping one entry for each product_id based on the minimum ctid.
queries: DELETE FROM products WHERE ctid NOT IN (SELECT MIN(ctid) FROM products GROUP BY product_id);
findings.explanation: Duplicate primary key entries in the 'products' table violate data integrity. This fix will delete duplicate rows, keeping one entry for each product_id based on the minimum ctid.
verification_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM products GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

cards.title: Remove duplicate primary key entries in products
cards.rationale: Duplicate primary key entries in the 'products' table violate data integrity. This fix will delete duplicate rows, keeping one entry for each product_id based on the minimum ctid.
cards.sql: DELETE FROM products WHERE ctid NOT IN (SELECT MIN(ctid) FROM products GROUP BY product_id);
verification_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM products GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

cards.title: Fix negative quantities in inventory
cards.rationale: Negative values in quantity columns (quantity_on_hand, quantity_reserved, quantity_available) are invalid and indicate data corruption. This fix will update all negative values in these columns to 0.
cards.sql: UPDATE inventory SET quantity_on_hand = GREATEST(quantity_on_hand, 0), quantity_reserved = GREATEST(quantity_reserved, 0), quantity_available = GREATEST(quantity_available, 0) WHERE quantity_on_hand < 0 OR quantity_reserved < 0 OR quantity_available < 0;
verification_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE quantity_on_hand < 0 OR quantity_reserved < 0 OR quantity_available < 0;

cards.sql: SELECT product_id, category_id, supplier_id FROM products WHERE category_id IS NULL OR supplier_id IS NULL LIMIT 10;

cards.title: Add index on departments.parent_department_id
cards.rationale: Adding an index on departments.parent_department_id will improve the performance of queries involving foreign key lookups and orphan checks, as it's a foreign key column.
cards.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_departments_parent_department_id ON departments (parent_department_id);
verification_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'departments' AND indexname = 'idx_departments_parent_department_id';
